text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product image, pure white background, soft studio light, portrait 2:3, no person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin or stand. Entire object fully visible. Brown double-breasted blazer over camel textured sweater and white collared shirt, ivory knee shorts, brown opaque tights and brown shoes.
original_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Keep this brown blazer, sweater, white shirt, ivory Bermuda shorts, brown tights and brown shoes. Arrange the empty brown tights and empty shoes flat beside the clothes, with no legs, skin, body or toes inside. No extra objects. Pure white seamless background, soft studio light, realistic materials, full uncropped portrait 2:3 1024x1536. No person, skin, anatomical body parts, visible mannequin, stand, labels, text, insets, collage or watermark. Change only the listed issues; preserve all remaining image details.
reproduction_note: 根据服装参考生成无人商品展示。遮挡或未展示的细节采用保守补全；文字和品牌细节仅为视觉参考。未进行逐图重新生成相似度验证。
